The structure of Li4Co2O4F4 (reduced formula Li2Co(OF)2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Fdd2 (No. 143), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with four neighbors (two F, two O) at 1.74–2.06 Å, while Li centers have six neighbors (two F, four O) at 1.91–2.30 Å. The Co- and Li-centered 4- and 6-vertex coordination polyhedra share corners and edges, and Li–Li polyhedra additionally share edges. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
